profile.headline: PHP / Python Enthusiast | Founder of AITEX
profile.summary:
Senior Python Engineer with 9+ years of expertise in building high-scale distributed systems handling millions of daily users. Passionate about solving complex backend challenges and implementing production-ready ML solutions. Led multiple engineering teams in delivering enterprise-grade applications using PHP, Laravel, Python, FastAPI, and TensorFlow.

Specialized in architecting performant APIs, real-time data processing pipelines, and ML systems. Proven track record of increasing system performance by 10x through optimized architectures and ML-driven solutions. Strong full-stack capabilities with React for data-intensive applications. Python and TensorFlow certified developer with deep expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure) and DevOps practices.

Core tech: PHP, Laravel, Python (FastAPI, Django), TensorFlow, React, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developed an enterprise-scale turbine monitoring system using Python, FastAPI, and React, enabling real-time performance tracking and predictive maintenance.

* Real-time turbine processing pipeline using Apache Kafka and Python's asyncio for handling 100K+ sensor readings per minute
* Machine learning models built with TensorFlow for anomaly detection and predictive maintenance, achieving 95% accuracy in failure prediction
* Interactive dashboard system using React and WebSocket for live turbine performance monitoring and alerts
* Automated report generation system using Celery for processing historical performance data and maintenance schedules
* REST API using FastAPI for seamless integration with existing Caterpillar enterprise systems
* Custom ETL pipelines for processing and analyzing turbine operational data using pandas and NumPy

Tech stack: Python 3.11, FastAPI, React, TensorFlow, Azure Cloud Services (AKS, AzureDB, Functions), TimescaleDB, Docker, Kafka, Celery

positions.title: Senior Back End Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Developed a scalable backend system for a telemedicine platform using PHP, Laravel and Python, FastAPI for the internal projects, facilitating real-time patient-doctor communications.

* Asynchronous service cost calculation engine using Python's asyncio for real-time pricing based on user parameters
* WebSocket-based chat system built with Laravel and Vue 3 for instant messaging between healthcare providers and patients
* Large medical report processing pipeline using RabbitMq for background tasks and AWS S3 for secure storage
* Revenue forecasting module utilizing pandas and scikit-learn for predictive analytics
* GraphQL API for efficient data querying and real time updates

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on 3 projects as a Senior Backend Developer

Moscow SaaS Platform (mos.ru)

* Developed core platform features using PHP, Laravel, Python, FastAPI and SQLAlchemy
* Configured Linux servers and managed deployments with Ansible and Docker
* Built RESTful APIs with Laravel and FastAPI and implemented microservices architecture
* Wrote integration tests using pytest within microservices environment

ERP System RTMIS

* Designed and implemented PHP microservices using Laravel and RabbitMQ
* Enhanced existing internal Django-based admin functionality with performance optimizations
* Created internal services and integrated with external APIs using aiohttp

Energosbyt Plus

* Improved architecture and codebase quality of Flask/Python application
* Developed new features for customer portal using Python and PostgreSQL
* Collaborated with React frontend team on API design and integration

positions.title: Team Lead of Backend Engineers Team
positions.description:
* Led deployment automation using PHP, Python, Docker and CI/CD pipelines for large-scale systems
* Evaluated technical solutions and architectures focusing on Python ecosystem and cloud infrastructure
* Increased backend team performance by 10x through technical leadership and process optimization
* Mentored team members on Backend best practices and architecture design patterns

educations.degreeName: 4 semesters of Bachelor's degree in Applied Informatics
